'''Clone major''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] held by [[Clone trooper officer/Legends|clone trooper officers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during their service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Guide" /> from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Like the other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]], clone [[Major/Legends|majors]] were [[Flash training|flash-trained]] for their leadership roles.<ref name="Guide" /> Along with [[clone battalion commander]]s, clone majors' command role was that of [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] leader. During the use of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Color/Legends|colors]] to signify rank, majors wore [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] with red markings. They shared this color with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captains]], though the two ranks' [[Heads-up display/Legends|HUD]] glyphs differed, with majors' being four vertical stripes while [[Captain/Legends|captains']] was only three.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Twelve]], designated CT-12/12-0068, held the rank of major and commanded the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps']] [[Hawkbat Battalion]]. [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] [[Jorir]], designated CT-43/76-9155, was another clone major and handled the [[Standard day/Legends|day]]-to-day operations of [[Squad Seven (Galactic Republic)|Squad Seven]], a specialist unit.<ref name="Guide" /> A clone major also served in an [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]].<ref name="Cross-Section">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of clone major was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book, ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="Cross-Section" />
